title.narrative: European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) phase III: funding for admin and programme management activities

description.narrative: Support the European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership to effectively deliver EDCTP programmes to benefit people in sub-Saharan Africa.

The UK Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) funds outstanding global health research through the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR). The Global Health European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership 3 (Global Health EDCTP3) Joint Undertaking works to deliver new solutions to reduce the burden of poverty-related infectious diseases in sub-Saharan Africa and to strengthen research capacities to prepare and respond to re-emerging infectious diseases. EDCTP Members who have committed to participating in Global Health EDCTP3 are required to make an annual contribution to the EDCTP Association administrative costs. NIHR as a member provides a funding contribution to the EDCTP Association annual administrative costs and EDCTP 3 programme management activities. This activity is a component of European and Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP) phase III (Global Health EDCTP3) programme (A7397_AA7398).
